description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectSkinDisease operation
description_zh: 本文介绍皮肤病检测DetectSkinDisease的语法及示例

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS link is in a region other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

BodyPart.description_en:
The identified body part of the skin lesion. Valid values:
scalp: scalp
face: face
neck: neck
arm: arm
chest: chest
abdomen: abdomen
oxter: armpit
back: back
waist: waist
hand: hand
genitals: genitals
cruris: inner thigh
leg: leg
foot: foot
unknown: unknown
BodyPart.description_zh:
皮损部位识别。取值如下：
scalp：头皮
face：脸
neck：颈部
arm：手臂
chest：胸部
abdomen：腹部
oxter：腋窝
back：背部
waist：腰部
hand：手
genitals：生殖器
cruris：腿部内侧
leg：腿
foot：脚
unknown：未知

ImageType.description_en:
The image classification. Valid values:

normal_skin: normal skin
skin_lesion: skin lesion image
non_skin: non-skin
ImageType.description_zh:
图像分类。取值如下：

normal_skin：正常皮肤
skin_lesion：皮损图片
non_skin：非皮肤
